## 2. Ready-to-paste comment / annotation

a(6) computed by an exact self-similar renormalization over the 4-corner boundary
state of the Sierpinski tetrahedron graph ST_n (ST_1 = K_4; ST_n = four copies of
ST_(n-1) with corner j of copy i identified to corner i of copy j — 6 shared corners,
4 outer corners; |V(ST_n)| = 4|V(ST_(n-1))| - 6 = 4,10,34,130,514,2050,8194; every edge
lies inside one copy, #edges = 6*4^(n-1)). Per corner the transfer records corner state = whether the corner is already covered (incident to a chosen edge) inside the gadget; a shared corner and every outer corner must end up covered;
the 6 shared corners are closed at each level and the 4 outer corners at the top, and
a(n) is the total sum P(1) of the exact generating polynomial. The method reproduces every
published term exactly, and the new term was verified by two independently-authored
programs (a Python renormalization and an independent C++/GMP transfer) that agree
digit-for-digit, both also passing an explicit-graph brute-force check on ST_1 and ST_2.
